title: Prepare and lodge a general report each year (CATSI corporations)
what: An Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander corporation registered under the Act prepares a general report each financial year and lodges it with the Registrar.

laws.title: Corporations (Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander) Act 2006

sources.quote: 330-1 Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander corporation must prepare a general report each financial year An Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander corporation must prepare a general report in respect of each financial year.
